newsitem.title: CHINA: China has too many futures brokerages - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: China has too many futures brokerages - newspaper.

text.p: An official newspaper on Friday said that China has too many futures brokerages and should close small brokerages to standardise the market.
The Shanghai Securities News said China now has more than 1,000 futures brokerages, some of them very small, compared with only around 200 in the United States.
"Our futures market has the problem of excessive competition with so many futures brokerages," the newspaper said.

The story parallels a recent crackdown on China's fledging futures markets. In the past week, the authorities have issued two documents emphasising curbs rather than expansion as the key note of the futures markets, at least for the time being.
